//: Server-Trust — Deno config for the chat Edge. The Edge imports ONE pre-bundled, self-contained ESM file (_server/serverBundle.mjs, generated by _server/build.mjs from src/features/chat/server/index.ts). That bundle inlines the entire runtime-neutral app graph (108 files incl. the FROZEN Saju engine) with NO extensionless/directory/@/ imports, so Deno resolves it directly — no `sloppy-imports`, no `@/` prefix map needed (the prior static sloppy-imports approach was NOT honored by the live Supabase runtime → worker boot 'Module not found'). Only the 3 engine deps stay external, mapped here to pinned npm: specifiers.
